articles.title: US Lowers Gas Mileage Rules for New Cars
articles.summary: The Trump administration rolled back fuel economy rules. By 2031, new cars and trucks must average 34.9 miles per gallon instead of over 50. The government says this cuts car prices by about $1,300.

articles.title: Hackers Say They Won't Share Stolen FBI Data
articles.summary: A hacking group called ShinyHunters says it stole private data about thousands of FBI workers. Now the group says it won't publish the information — but it can't promise the data is safe.

articles.title: Starship Goes to Orbit for the First Time!
articles.summary: SpaceX's giant Starship rocket reached orbit for the first time on Monday, launching from Boca Chica Beach in Texas. It also dropped off 26 Starlink internet satellites before splashing down near Hawaii.
